title: arabesque ribbon · architectural growth
concept: 5gm's 3D differential growth, but the curve is rendered as a wide flat RIBBON oriented with width perpendicular to the growth axis — like a continuous architectural strip spiraling up. Width oscillates with arabesque flare. Antique-gold metalness with key+rim+ambient lighting catches the curvature. Mughal-Persian arabesque on a column, Frank Gehry continuous-ribbon energy.
